extra.reason: Agreed with the owner on 2026-11-01: real map + live location for V1; Google Maps remains external navigation; turn-by-turn is a separate project.

Built signed 0.1.2 (versionCode 3) APK/AAB from current source. Verified CN=Three Layer Brands, automotive_app_desc + minCarApiLevel, local wallpaper, and AAB manifest. release/ now holds the 0.1.2 artifacts and SHA256SUMS; old 0.1.0 files removed.

Research complete: no supported no-root data API in the installed Kia Connect app. No exported vehicle-data components, no AA integration, cert-pinned authenticated cloud API. Use NotificationListener for optional event hints only; OBD-II remains the real telemetry path; official business API only with partner access.

Implemented a snapshot-based MapLibre approach: MapLibre 13.6.1 MapSnapshotter renders the OpenFreeMap dark style at 1920x720 and publishes a bitmap to the shared Canvas renderer. Real map + location verified in the phone launcher; car surface pass is tracked by omarchy-jyi.5.
OpenFreeMap dark style is used, with a light Omarchy tint, live map labels, and visible © OpenStreetMap contributors · OpenFreeMap attribution. Phone verified; car pass tracked by omarchy-jyi.5.

Live location now feeds a centered map camera and heading puck; speed and GPS LIVE/WAIT remain from the existing LocationWatcher. Phone launcher verified with a real fix; car pass tracked by omarchy-jyi.5.
